title: Clinicians and Patients on Trust in Medical AI Diagnostics
discussion_signal: The discussion frames trust in diagnostic AI as use-case dependent and highlights accuracy, explainability, liability, bias, patient awareness, and the continuing preference for clinician-led AI-assisted decisions.
linked_research_question: Why does trust in healthcare AI vary by diagnostic task, and what forms of clinical accountability make adoption feel legitimate to patients and clinicians?
limits: The post describes a survey-based report without providing the full sample or estimates
It does not establish clinical performance or patient outcomes
A professional discussion may overrepresent adoption and governance concerns relative to non-users
